passages.text: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has power and authority.
The writer speaks to the LORD.
The writer asks a question.
The writer says, "Why do You stand far away, LORD?"
The writer asks another question.
The writer says, "Why do You hide Yourself when there is trouble?"
passages.original: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃

passages.text: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
passages.sermon:
The wicked act with pride.
The wicked chase after the needy.
The wicked make plans to harm others.
Let the wicked become trapped by their own schemes.
passages.original: בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ׀ בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ׃

passages.text: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man acts with pride.
He boasts about the desires in his heart.
He praises those who are greedy.
He speaks against the LORD.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל־ תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ׀ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man acts with pride.
He does not seek God.
He makes many schemes.
God is not in any of his plans.
passages.original: רָשָׁ֗ע כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ בַּל־ יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כָּל־ מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man feels secure in everything he does.
He always trusts his own ways.
He does this at all times.
God, your judgments are high and far away from him.
He does not see your justice.
He looks down on all his enemies.
He sneers at everyone who opposes him.
passages.original: יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דַרְכּוֹ בְּכָל־ עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ כָּל־ צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”
passages.sermon:
The wicked man is proud.
He does not seek God.
He trusts in himself.
He says in his heart, “I will not be moved.”
He believes nothing will shake him.
He thinks he will never face trouble.
He feels secure for all generations.
He believes he will always be free from distress.
passages.original: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל־ אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ בְרָֽע׃

passages.text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man speaks evil words.
He fills his mouth with curses.
He speaks lies and deceives others.
He uses violent language.
He hides trouble under his tongue.
He keeps malice in his words.
passages.original: אָלָ֤ה פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man hides near the villages.
He waits in secret places.
He kills innocent people.
He watches the helpless with hidden eyes.
He looks for a chance to harm them.
He acts with stealth and cruelty.
passages.original: יֵשֵׁ֤ב׀ בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man hides in secret places.
He waits quietly, like a lion hiding in a thicket.
He plans to attack people who are poor and oppressed.
He grabs the poor when they pass by.
He traps the lowly in his net.
passages.original: יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר׀ כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמָשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They are crushed and beaten down; the hapless fall prey to his strength.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man uses his strength.
He crushes people.
He beats them down.
Helpless people fall because of his power.
The weak become his victims.

passages.text: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
passages.sermon:
The wicked man speaks in his heart.
He says, “God has forgotten.”
He believes God hides His face.
He thinks God never sees anything forever.
passages.original: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל־ רָאָ֥ה לָנֶֽצַח׃

passages.text: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to the LORD.
The LORD is God.
The psalmist calls to God for help.
He says, “Arise, LORD.”
He says, “Lift up Your hand, God.”
He says, “Do not forget the helpless.”
passages.original: קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אַל־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח עֲנִיִּים׃

passages.text: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”
passages.sermon: The wicked man rejects God.\r\nHe says in his heart, “God will not judge me.”\r\nHe believes God will never call him to account.
passages.original: עַל־ מֶ֤ה׀ נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִּדְרֹֽשׁ׃

passages.text: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
passages.sermon:
God sees trouble.
God sees grief.
God looks at these things.
God repays trouble and grief by His own hand.
The victim leaves his cause with God.
God helps the fatherless.
passages.original: רָאִ֡תָה כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה׀ עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס׀ תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֪ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ עָ֭לֶיךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֶ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה׀ הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר׃

passages.text: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
passages.sermon:
God, you are just and powerful.
You see the actions of every person.
The wicked man does evil.
The evildoer harms others.
Break the strength of the wicked man.
Stop the evildoer from doing harm.
Hold the wicked man accountable for his evil deeds.
Search out all his wickedness.
Do not let any evil remain.
passages.original: שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ־ רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל־ תִּמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is King.
He rules forever.
He rules for all time.
Nations disappear from His land.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵֽאַרְצֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear, to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.
passages.sermon:
The LORD listens to the humble.
The LORD hears their desires.
The LORD strengthens their hearts.
The LORD pays close attention to them.
The LORD judges for the fatherless.
The LORD judges for the oppressed.
The LORD acts so that people will not terrify others on earth anymore.
passages.original: תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אָזְנֶֽךָ׃ לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫דָ֥ךְ בַּל־ יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד לַעֲרֹ֥ץ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
